file.title: Upload files

dropzone.title: Drag images here or click to select files
dropzone.paste: Or <kbd>{{mod}}</kbd> + <kbd>V</kbd> to paste images from clipboard
dropzone.description: Attach as many files as you like, they will show up below to review before uploading.

file.showAllTooltip: This may cause performance issues if there are a lot of files

mayFail.title: Upload may fail
mayFail.message: The upload may fail because the total size of the files (that are not being partially uploaded) you are trying to upload is {{size}}, which is larger than the limit of {{limit}}

options.title: Upload Options
options.description: These options will be applied to all files you upload and are saved in your browser.

deletesAt.label: Deletes at
deletesAt.description: The file will automatically delete itself after this time.
deletesAt.defaultExpiration: The default expiration time is {{value}} (you can override this with the below option).
deletesAt.setDefault: You can set a default expiration time in the <link>settings</link>.

expirations.custom: Need more freedom? Set an exact date and time through the API.

format.label: Name Format
format.description: The file name format to use when uploading this file, the "File name" field will override this value.
format.name: Use file name

compressionFormat.label: Compression Format
compressionFormat.description: The image compression format to use only when a compression percent is specified. Leave at "default" to use the server default compression format.

compression.label: Compression
compression.description: The compression level to use on images (only). The above format will be used to compress images. Leave blank to disable compression.

maxViews.label: Max Views
maxViews.description: The maximum number of views the files can have before they are deleted. Leave blank to allow as many views as you want.

folder.label: Add to a Folder
folder.description: Add this file to a folder. Use the "/ (Root)" option to not add the file to a folder. This value is not saved to your browser, and is cleared after uploading.

filename.label: Override File Name
filename.description: Override the file name with this value. Leave blank to use the "Name Format" option. This value is ignored if you are uploading more than one file. This value is not saved to your browser, and is cleared after uploading.

password.label: Password
password.description: Set a password for these files. Leave blank to disable password protection. This value is not saved to your browser, and is cleared after uploading.

originalName.label: Add Original Name
originalName.description: Add the original file name, so that the file can be downloaded with the original name. This will still use the "Name Format" option for its file name.

extensionless.label: Extensionless URL
extensionless.description: Remove the file extension from the returned URL. The file can still be accessed with its extension. This option will only work if the server is configured to allow extensionless URLs.

modal.open: Open link in a new tab
modal.pending_one: {{count}} large file will finish <link>processing in the background.</link>
modal.pending_other: {{count}} large files will finish <link>processing in the background.</link>
modal.copyAllTooltip: Copy all links to clipboard (separated by a new line)

copiedAll.title: Copied URLs to clipboard
copiedAll.message: Copied all URLs to clipboard separated by a new line.

complete.title: Large file uploads complete
complete.message_one: Offloaded {{count}} large file for background processing
complete.message_other: Offloaded {{count}} large files for background processing
